_comment: P8 verify waivers for g0-sense. ONE entry, covering exactly the single residual check_thermal error and nothing else. The other four P8 errors were resolved on their merits, not suppressed: the check_pdn VBUS error was a genuine DATA gap (C1, the 100 nF at the connector that constraints.json names as the only capacitance ahead of the PTC, was missing from decoupling.json's inventory - adding the real association dropped it to a warning); and all three check_current errors were fixed in copper by the P8 fixer (two via clusters taken from 2 to 3 vias with measured clearances, and a per-zone pour artifact resolved by re-assigning vias to fills). No constraints.json, .kicad_dru, .kicad_pro, netclass or gate definition was edited anywhere in P7 or P8. P9 RE-ISSUE: the silk move_text/add_text edits changed the board digest, which correctly invalidated the P8-issued waiver. Re-bound to 78f20b4b after confirming the finding is unchanged (same area, same theta_JA, same rise) - the silk edits touch no copper.

waivers.approved: orchestrator under owner delegation, unattended container run 2026-08-27 (run-contract delegation rules 1-2 and rule 4: 'if a checker is wrong, waive with the evidence and journal it'). RE-ISSUED at P9 against board digest 78f20b4b after the silk text edits changed the board (the digest binding did exactly its job and invalidated the P8 issue). Bound to board digest 78f20b4b and check_thermal checker_version 1: if the board changes at P9 this waiver stops matching and must be re-issued against the new digest.
waivers.reason: MODEL PESSIMISM AGAINST TWO VENDOR MEASUREMENT TABLES, on a board that MEETS its own declared limit - plus a measured proof that no geometry on this outline can satisfy the model. (1) WHAT THE CHECKER SAYS: theta_JA(A) = 55 + (174-55)*exp(-A/350) for 1 oz / 2-layer (check_thermal.py:47,55). At the delivered 249.9 mm2 of credited +3V3 copper that yields 113.3 C/W and a 57.8 C rise at 0.51 W, against the 45 C declared in constraints.json thermal[]. (2) WHY THE MODEL IS WRONG HERE: it credits only same-net top copper and gives NO credit for backside spreading, while this board has a 813.2 mm2 solid B.Cu GND pour directly under and around U1. Knowledge record ldo-sot223-thermal-copper-sets-current states explicitly that the spreading layer NEED NOT BE ELECTRICALLY CONNECTED, so that pour is a legitimate spreader the model cannot see. Against the vendors' own measurements for this exact package: AMS1117 datasheet p5 Table 1 (1/16 in FR-4, 1 oz) measures 80 C/W for 100 mm2 top plus a backside pour, and TI LM1117 Table 9-2 measures 84 C/W at 0.3 in2 = 194 mm2 - this board has MORE top copper than either row and a large backside pour. The model's own calibration error is visible at those anchor points: it returns 144 C/W where AMS measured 80, and 123 C/W where TI measured 84. (3) THE BOARD PASSES ON MEASURED DATA: at the conservative vendor anchor of 84 C/W the rise is 0.51 x 84 = 42.8 C, INSIDE the 45 C budget, giving Tj = 82.8 C at 40 C ambient; at AMS's 80 C/W it is 40.8 C and Tj 80.8 C. Against the 125 C junction limit the margins are: realistic 0.24 A draw (0.26 W) Tj 61.8 C, governing rated case (0.51 W) Tj 82.8 C, entitlement-abuse case (0.83 W) Tj 109.7 C. Every case clears, the worst by 15 C. (4) NO GEOMETRY CAN PASS THE MODEL: satisfying it needs theta_JA <= 88.2 C/W, i.e. >= 446.4 mm2 of credited copper. The P8 fixer measured the ceiling - if EVERY free mm2 of front copper on the whole board were assigned to +3V3 (0.127 mm clearance to foreign copper, 0.3 mm edge, 0.25 mm min fill), only 439.9 mm2 falls inside the checker's 14.33 mm reach disc, giving 88.9 C/W and 45.3 C - still over. The finding is unreachable by construction on a 35.79 x 28.34 mm outline. (5) WHAT WAS ACTUALLY DONE RATHER THAN WAIVED: the pour was grown from 171.1 to 249.9 mm2 credited (285.6 mm2 total F.Cu +3V3) with a priority-2 solid-connect annex zone, cutting the modelled rise from 65.3 to 57.8 C - a real improvement kept even though it does not clear the gate. (6) WHAT WAS DELIBERATELY NOT DONE: ~12 mm2 in the right strip was left unclaimed because it walks a thermal spreader up to the U3 sensor tongue root, and no +3V3 island or thermal-via array was added on B.Cu. Both would help thermally; both would carve the ground return plane of a 2-layer board, trading a PASSING check_return_path for margin the vendor data says is not needed, and both contradict the recorded P2 decision that B.Cu stays GND-only over U1. The SHT40 thermal isolation contract (B4) outranks the LDO spreader: verified intact after the pour growth at 0.0000 mm2 of fill inside the tongue on both layers, exactly 4 necked crossings.
